subject: Post-call: Buying map, security intake & next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwell.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-05-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Buying map, security intake & next steps

Hi Tom and Priya —

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary (2 min):
- Use case: FinWell wants Redwood to serve inference for clinical summarization and patient-facing question answering (low-latency production API).
- Priority constraints: EU data residency for production records; SOC 2 + vendor risk checklist required by procurement; timeline: target pilot in Q3 (prototype in 6–8 weeks).

Primary asks from our side:
1) Who is the economic buyer / procurement approver for this engagement? (Name & email)
2) Security intake: I’ve attached our intake questionnaire (redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf). Please have your security or IT team fill the relevant sections (systems in scope, data flows, third-party integrations).
3) Systems in scope: please confirm whether the following are in-scope: production Postgres (RDS), S3 buckets holding PHI-derived artifacts, analytics pipelines, and any on-prem EHR connectors. If possible include VPC IDs or owners.
4) Procurement steps: required PO/contracting lead time and any legal redlines you expect (standard vs. limited liability for PHI).
5) Suggested next meetings:
   - Security scoping call (45m) with your SecOps + our security lead (Monica).
   - Procurement sync (20m) with buyer and our commercial lead (Neha).

Proposed timeline:
- This week: FinWell completes as much of the attached intake as possible + provides procurement contact.
- Week of 5/25: Security scoping call.
- June: Contract & PO discussions; technical onboarding prep.

I can coordinate calendars once you confirm owners.

One note on deployment: we can support EU-region hosted deployment (Redwood Dedicated in eu-west-1) or a private deployment if you require on-prem data residency guarantees. We’ll surface the tradeoffs on the security call (latency/cost vs. guarantee).

Thanks — I’ll wait for the intake and procurement contact to book the scoping call.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwell.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Buying map, security intake & next steps

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers below and I attached our vendor risk profile so you can see the fields our procurement will care about (FinWell_Vendor_Risk_Profile.pdf).

- Economic buyer / procurement approver: Priya Singh (priya.singh@finwell.ai) — she owns vendor approval and the commercial sign-off.
- Systems in scope: production RDS (postgres-prod.rds.finwell), S3 buckets (s3://finwell-prod-artifacts), analytics cluster (k8s-prod in AWS account 987654321), and our EHR connector nodes (on-prem VM hosts). Staging/dev are NOT in scope for the pilot.
- Data residency: yes, production must remain in EU (we cannot export PHI to non-EU regions).
- Procurement steps: our standard process: vendor questionnaire (we filled one, attached), security scoping call, legal review (~2 weeks), PO issuance. We do sometimes request a short SOW to attach to the PO.

I’ll route the intake PDF to our security team and Priya will be looped for procurement. We are available next week for a security call — Tue or Thu mornings CET work best.

Tom
Head of IT Operations
FinWell Health

Attachment: FinWell_Vendor_Risk_Profile.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwell.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Buying map, security intake & next steps — FinWell scoping items

Team — forwarding FinWell’s responses and their vendor risk profile. Action items and proposed ownership below.

Context: FinWell is EU-based and requires production data to remain in EU. They’re targeting a pilot (clinical summarization) with PHI-derived artifacts in S3 and production Postgres RDS. Procurement lead is Priya (CPO). Timeline: scoping call next week, legal review in June.

Proposed ownership: 
- Monica: lead security scoping call + questionnaire intake (primary contact for their SecOps).
- Rishi: technical onboarding follow-up (kernel/latency expectations, model variant questions, dev/prod separation).
- Neha: commercial/contracting lead — coordinate with Priya on SOW and standard PO language; monitor liability requirements for PHI.

Specific asks for the scoping call (please review before call):
- Confirm our EU-hosting options (dedicated vs. private) and list concretes: encryption at rest (KMS), key ownership options, SOC2 report availability, access control model.
- Prepare a concise environment matrix: what we support (RDS, S3, k8s) and where we’d need network access (VPC peering, IP whitelisting, or customer VPN).
- Bring a short slide (2–3 bullets) on our data residency guarantees and fallback (e.g., automatic routing to eu region, fallback to Private).

I attached both questionnaires to this thread. I’ll propose Tue 05/19 09:00 CET or Thu 05/21 10:30 CET for the security call (Tom preferred Tue/Thu AM CET). If you’re good, I’ll send a calendar invite and include FinWell SecOps and Priya.

Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf, FinWell_Vendor_Risk_Profile.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finwell.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwell.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: Buying map, security intake & next steps — FinWell scoping items

Thanks Hannah — I’ll take point for the security kickoff. A few quick notes and what I need before the call: 

1) Meeting: Tue 2026-05-19 09:00 CET works for me. Please go ahead and book; include Robert Chen (security engineer) and I’ll bring our compliance checklist.
2) Pre-call requests for FinWell:
   - Network diagram (minimal): VPCs, subnets, exposed endpoints, and owners.
   - Environment scope confirmation (you indicated RDS + S3 + k8s-prod + on-prem EHR connectors). Please add VPC IDs if available.
   - Clarify whether the S3 buckets contain raw PHI or de-identified artifacts — impacts encryption/key management.
3) Options we’ll present: EU-hosted Dedicated (redwood-dedicated eu-west-1), Private deployment (on-prem or VPC), and our hybrid fallback. For EU residency guarantees, Private is the only path to guarantee air-gapped on-prem; Dedicated in an EU region meets most procurement needs when combined with a contract clause.
4) Docs I’ll bring: SOC 2 Type II summary, KMS integration patterns, and sample encryption-at-rest architecture. If Legal needs an NDA before we share SOC2, flag and we’ll route.

Rishi — can you draft a 1-slide environment matrix and 2 bullets on latency expectations and KV cache behavior for the call? Neha — can you prep a short summary of standard contract terms around data residency and PO timing?

Monica Patel
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
notes: Thread includes two attachments from internal and external sides. Internal meeting proposed for 2026-05-19 to scope EU-residency and security questionnaire intake.
